paper_title: MICROSCOPE mission: first constraints on the violation of the weak equivalence principle by a light scalar dilaton
coupling_convention: dimensionless alpha (coupling strength relative to gravity), for q=B
notes: MICROSCOPE WEP test. Main quoted results: |alpha|<1e-11 for scalar coupled to baryon number B, and |alpha|<1e-12 for B-L, valid for m_phi < 1e-12 eV (range > few 1e5 m). Emitted the B-coupled bound as a flat horizontal line. The B-L result (1e-12) would correspond to VectorBL-like coupling. Numerical exclusion curves in Figs 1-5 are plots only; no tables. The 2-sigma Eotvos limit is eta=(-1+/-27)e-15. Mass range chosen as lower bound approximate (constraints saturate below 1e-14 eV); upper bound 1e-12 eV is where MICROSCOPE loses sensitivity.
